bug: Autosave transitions and observer delivery called the public getStatus method internally. Overrides could throw during persistence bookkeeping, fabricate notifications, clear listeners through a false disposed snapshot, or reenter disposal.

before.observations: Six method/accessor override cases interrupted markDirty, flush or dispose. Two fabricated-state cases broke the canonical notification sequence. A reentrant status override executed during scheduling.

fix: Move canonical status snapshot construction into a private method; preserve the public getStatus return contract by delegating to it.
Use the private snapshot for transition fingerprints and observer delivery, without invoking public overrides.

scenarios: React demo edits, formats, replays history, persists/reloads and remains accessible.
Autosave observation retains a dirty-to-saved transition even when complete before the action returns.
Autosave observation rejects an unchanged initial idle status.

limits: This fixes overridden status methods/accessors, not isolation from arbitrary same-origin code.
Notification coalescing, listener-driven lifecycle actions and already-dispatched storage semantics remain unchanged.
No durable format, Rust implementation, public status shape, package version or release budget changed.
The separate WebKit numeric fault remains unresolved; native instrumentation stayed paused.
No full release qualification, commit, push or publication is claimed.
